semanticVersioning.major: slot removal, type change, stronger requirement or projection meaning change
semanticVersioning.minor: compatible optional slot or projection addition
semanticVersioning.patch: copy, preview or validation fix without save meaning change

archetypes.label: 반복 루틴
archetypes.sourceShape: user title + anchor + optional user-named phases + user-named recurring items
canonicalRules: Step is grouping only and is created only when it has at least one user Item
phase duration stays in StructureDraft generation metadata when windowStrategy is phase
each Item recurrence is bounded by the selected phase or global window
DTSTART is the first real selected weekday within the selected phase or global window
COUNT and UNTIL are mutually exclusive
open-ended recurrence is excluded from P0

archetypes.label: D-day 준비
archetypes.sourceShape: user title + event anchor + user-named groups + offset, absolute or recurring Items
canonicalRules: offset schedule requires a user anchor
user-named groups do not imply a hidden date range

archetypes.label: 일정+준비
archetypes.sourceShape: user departure date + preparation Items + user-named itinerary groups + timed/place Items
canonicalRules: preparation and itinerary use the same canonical Item model
date views never duplicate canonical Items
itinerary date must be on or after the user departure date
ordinary prose stays TXT or Memo

validationRules.rule: each session has at least one occurrence inside its phase window
validationRules.message: 이 단계 안에 실제 운동 날짜가 생기도록 요일을 확인해 주세요.
시각을 넣었다면 캘린더 소요시간도 입력해 주세요.

canaryChecks: all six templates have one positive p0.2 fixture
fixture values conform to declared field types and enum options
group instance IDs are unique and stable within a draft
all validation errors and planner warnings carry scopeInstanceId
template selection creates zero source changes
previewFixture values never appear in a source plan
seed rows receive stable sidecar IDs but empty rows produce zero source lines, Steps and Items
relative offsets serialize as D-minus, D-Day or D-plus and weekdays serialize in Monday-to-Sunday order
global recurrence end values broadcast to all descendant sessions
propagated timezone and itinerary group dates do not create derived value log entries
materialization requires a matching source fingerprint
materialization calls the raw source callback once
one undo restores the entire pre-materialization source
ordinary prose remains TXT with importAssist disabled
one canonical Item ID is preserved across projections
template detach preserves raw source byte-for-byte
save failure preserves raw source and StructureDraft
empty raw source restores an unmaterialized sidecar draft
open-ended recurrence, invalid IANA timezone and conflicting schedule modes fail closed
shared and template validation rule codes are unique
definition IDs, versions and slot IDs are unique
expected and forbidden projections are both fixture-tested
private and sensitive fields are excluded from default exports
template retirement keeps pinned user instances readable
internal canary status never implies public or observed-user validation
